name: Bun song than
summary: Mung-bean noodles from An Thái. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the name comes from pulling the strands in pairs, and that some people say song thần. The city tourism introduction names the bowl and does not describe it.
origin: Phường Bình Định, thị xã An Nhơn. The verse on the portal says An Thái.
howToEat: The portal says the noodles are cooked with shrimp or lean pork, and that An Thái serves a bowl with chicken offal. Dry noodles are sold to take away.
It says 5 kg of beans yield 1.2 kg of flour and 1 kg of noodles, and that the price is high. A number was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: An Thái, in An Nhơn. Not a street in the Quy Nhon center.
seoTitle: Bun Song Than — mung-bean noodles in An Nhon
seoDescription: Bún Song Thằn is mung-bean noodles from An Thái in An Nhơn, cooked with shrimp, lean pork, or chicken offal. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
